name: General Output Quality
description: Measures whether an answer is accurate, relevant, clear, complete, specific and useful.

name: Instruction Adherence
description: Measures compliance with explicit task requirements, constraints and requested format.

name: Evidence Discipline
description: Measures whether claims are supported, assumptions are explicit and uncertainty is not concealed.

name: Technical Correctness
description: Measures correctness of technical explanations, code reasoning and implementation details.

name: Actionability
description: Measures whether the output can be used directly to execute a decision, workflow or next step.

name: Format Compliance
description: Measures whether the requested structure, schema or artifact format is satisfied.
